title: Cute idea but pricy
text:
Cute idea but pricy. This is a cute idea. It just isn’t worth the price. For $37, these are just three pieces of painted on wood. They aren’t make to looks like books in any way aside from being roughly book shaped. There isn’t any painting to look like pages or a binding or anything.

The three blocks are just painted white with some edges worn off and the black block printing on one side. It comes pre tied with some brown packing string.

Again, I think they are cute but I cannot justify spending $37 on something that would cost less than $10 to DIY.
